I don’t have the transcript or the DDx JSON — please paste both so I can generate the requested SOAP note.

What I need from you
- Full raw transcript (conversation between clinician and patient).
- The DDx JSON provided by the diagnostic agent.

Optional but helpful
- Any vitals, exam findings, labs, or imaging results if not in the transcript.
- Clarify whether you want the note for outpatient or inpatient setting.

When you paste them I will:
- Treat the transcript as the primary source.
- Use the DDx only where consistent with the transcript (flagging conflicts).
- Produce a concise SOAP note in the exact structure you requested.
